# Wysp

> Wysp builds small, local-first software products. Each product has its own
> microsite under this domain with full feature, pricing and privacy detail.

## Products

- [Reel — Discord Chat Exporter & AI Search](https://wysp.pro/reel/): Chrome
  extension that exports Discord chat to Excel (XLSX), CSV, JSON or browsable
  HTML — a whole server in one run, channels, threads and forum posts included.
  The archive stays on the user's device, searchable by keyword or on-device
  semantic meaning, with an optional AI research agent (Pro) that answers
  questions with citations. Not affiliated with Discord.
  - Privacy policy: https://wysp.pro/reel/privacy/
- [Lanes](https://wysp.pro/lanes/): native macOS menu-bar app that names
  Spaces, switches between them fast, and runs per-Lane automations.
- [Trust Contract](https://wysp.pro/trust-contract/): privacy-first Discord
  hiring marketplace run end to end by a bot — anonymous job posts, private
  deal rooms, and a behavior-based trust score.
- [Klinex](https://wysp.pro/klinex/): describe a world in one sentence and
  Klinex co-designs and builds a real, playable 3D game you own.
